evidence: Describes A pausing past 30 seconds, B acquiring token 2 and processing the same job, then A resuming so both can call Apply and MarkDone.
Requires completion storage to reject tokens older than the highest accepted token, but does not explicitly require Store.MarkDone to perform the comparison atomically.

States Apply cannot enforce fencing and suggests changing that boundary or using a fenced coordinator, but does not explicitly explain why a lease pre-check is insufficient or require the full fenceable-durable-boundary plus stable-idempotency-and-reconciliation construction.
Calls failed or ambiguous renewals uncertain authority and requires stopping effects past the last provable expiry; later says work must stop when renewal cannot prove authority.

Requires an explicit cancellation source, join point, and termination before Release/return, but does not explicitly require deriving renewal from the Run lifecycle instead of an unowned background context.
Requires renew and release to conditionally mutate only the exact lease identity or fencing token so stale owners cannot alter newer leases.
Gives the lost-success-response schedule where the first Apply takes effect, returns an error, and a retry duplicates the effect.
Requires one stable job identity and replay-safe recovery through idempotency or authoritative reconciliation.
States that all three Apply calls can fail without taking effect, after which MarkDone still records completion.
States MarkDone failure is discarded and requires an unsuccessful completion write to prevent successful processing or release.
Explicitly says the two owners permit six remote attempts and all six may take effect.
Does not require one end-to-end deadline or classify transient, permanent, and ambiguous failures before retry.
Does not claim acquisition or renewal alone prevents stale effects; it says lease-based single execution is impossible without authoritative fencing.
Does not endorse continuing after uncertain renewal; it requires stopping when authority cannot be proved.
Does not propose retrying Apply under a fresh identity; it requires a stable job identity.
Criticizes ignored Renew and MarkDone results and requires conditional Release handling; it does not approve ignoring these errors.
verdict.summary: The candidate establishes 8 of 12 required invariants. Missing or insufficiently explicit points are atomic fencing in Store.MarkDone, the specific insufficiency of lease pre-checks and complete fenceable-boundary construction, Run-scoped renewal context ownership, and end-to-end retry deadline/failure classification. No forbidden outcome is endorsed.
